:::{#exr-dim-sum-practice}
#### Finding the dimension of a sum of two planes in $\reals^4$

@thm-dim-sum finds the [dimension](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-dimension) of a [sum of two subspaces](#def-subspace-sum)
without describing it.
Let $\mathcal{S}_1 = \operatorname{span}\cb{\vecf{e}_1, \vecf{e}_2}$
and $\mathcal{S}_2 = \operatorname{span}\cb{\vecf{e}_2, \vecf{e}_3}$,
two planes in $\reals^4$,
where $\vecf{e}_1, \ldots, \vecf{e}_4$ are the [indicator vectors](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-indicator-vector) of $\reals^4$.

Find $\dim(\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2)$ from @thm-dim-sum.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

First find $\mathcal{S}_1 \cap \mathcal{S}_2$ by comparing entries.

:::

:::
